name: the-suite-runs-on-a-mac
find:
run: pytest -v -n auto --durations=25

  # The same suite on a Mac
replace:
run: pytest -v -n auto --durations=25 -k "not reel"

  # The same suite on a Mac
breaks: a leg narrows itself with a -k expression, which selects by name and so covers less every time a test is renamed with nothing reporting it, while both legs go on reporting under the same name (#510, #995)
